id: F-009
category: bad-gate
expect: flagged
area: build
rule: docs/retro-log.md

# PASS defined as an absence, so mediocrity passed five runs running

A design gate defined PASS as "zero VIOLATION" -- broke no rule. Compliant, characterless
work passed five consecutive runs, and no part of the loop could report that the output was
simply not good enough.

A quality gate needs a finding class that fails for insufficiency, not only for rule-breaking.
